channel.title: Velneo — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by Velneo (velneo).

item.title: CVE-2026-114462 · 6 MEDIUM — Arbitrary File Read via Symlink in Velneo vServer HTTP Server
item.description: Improper link resolution before file access ('link following') vulnerability in Velneo vServer. This issue affects vServer: from 32.3 before 36.6 and from 37.1 before 37.2.

item.title: CVE-2026-114405 · 8.7 HIGH 🌩️ — Denial of Service via Malformed VATP Packet in Velneo vServer
item.description: Improper validation of array index vulnerability in Velneo vServer. This issue affects vServer: from 36.0 before 36.6 and from 37.0 before 37.2.
